#!/bin/bash
# Post-receive hook to deploy changes to web server
WEB_DIR="/var/www"
GIT_DIR="/git/server"

while read oldrev newrev refname
do
    if [ "$refname" = "refs/heads/master" ]; then
        echo "Deploying master branch to web directory..."
        git --work-tree=$WEB_DIR --git-dir=$GIT_DIR checkout -f

    fi
done
EOF
